                                       CHAPTER 6

                      FIELD MAINTENANCE INSTRUCTIONS

       Note. This chapter contains information for field maintenance. The amount of repair that can be performed
by units having field maintenance responsibility is limited only by the tools and test equipment available, and by the skill
of the repairman.

Section |. TROUBLE SHOOTING AT FIELD MAINTENANCE LEVEL

      Warning: When servicing the radio transmitter, be extremely careful because of the high volt-

ages exposed. Keep one hand in a pocket when measuring socket voltages with the probe. Before
touching any part after the voltage is shut off, short the part to ground.

66. Continuity Tests for Cables and Terminal             specified, there is an open circuit in the circuit
        Strips                                           under test. Check the circuit for poorly soldered
                                                         or broken connections, burned-out fuses, poor con-
   a. Defects in the transmitter can be detected         tacts between plug and sockets, and loose connec-
by performing resistance tests of continuity             tion at terminal strips. Also, by these tests, short
through cables and terminals in accordance with          circuits and defective parts may be located. Make
the procedure outlined in tables XIII and IV.            the necessary repairs and replacements.

   b. Perform tests on an ohmmeter range that               c. Perform these tests with the a-c power off,
permits a reading close to the center of the scale.      the tubes removed, except where indicated other-
If the readings obtained do not agree with those         wise, three transmitter tuning units inserted, and
specified in the tables, within plus or minus 10 per-    all plugs connected in their proper sockets.
cent, the circuit is defective. If an infinite reading
is obtained in a test for which less than .1 ohm is         Caution. Be sure that the switches are in the
                                                         specified positions required for the test.
